title: Add RAG agent templates, tool-calling quickstarts, and docs site updates
author: Priya Patel
description: Motivation: Provide first-class RAG agent templates and end-to-end tool-calling quickstarts for Python/TypeScript SDKs so customers can onboard to agent-based workflows faster. This PR introduces a curated set of RAG agent YAML templates, worked examples that demonstrate tool-calling and structured outputs, and updates to the docs site to surface quickstarts and playbooks. Summary of changes: added RAG agent templates (templates/rag/*), two SDK quickstarts (examples/quickstarts/agents/python-tool-calling.ipynb and examples/quickstarts/agents/ts-tool-calling.md), updated redwood-examples with completed playbooks, and docs site navigation and code snippets to match API and SDK improvements. Checklist: - [x] Add RAG agent templates and sample config - [x] Add Python quickstart notebook and guide - [x] Add TypeScript quickstart and example repo link - [x] Update docs site nav and examples page - [x] Add basic unit tests for template validation - [x] Fix CI failures and confirm builds pass Local testing: validated Python quickstart end-to-end against local dev server, ran docs build (mkdocs) and smoke-tested quickstart pages. Backwards compatibility: templates are additive and default example configs should not affect existing customers. Related: ENG-4521, PM-312, SUP-789. Please see commit list and review comments for implementation notes and follow-ups.

human_readable_summary: This PR adds a set of RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) agent templates and end-to-end quickstarts demonstrating tool-calling in both Python and TypeScript SDKs, plus docs site updates to surface the new examples. CI initially failed on a lint issue which was fixed; the PR was approved by reviewers and merged via squash. The change is additive and includes template validation tests and updated example playbooks.
